_about: Men's tops size charts by shop, read from each shop's own size guide. Inches. kind: body = to fit chest, garment = the garment's own chest. Checked date is when it was read.

ASOS.note: ASOS DESIGN men's guide (ASOS's own label); other brands on ASOS use their own charts

AllSaints.note: menswear clothing chart in inches, one chest value per size

Alpkit.note: men's T-shirt chart: half chest 2.5cm below the armhole, doubled

Berghaus.note: men's chart for jackets, fleeces, base layers, shirts and tees (shown on product pages)

Blue Inc.note: one chart for all tops, knitwear, jackets, coats and shirts

Brook Taverner.note: shirts chart; the collar is the shirt's own measurement

Burton.note: tops, shirts, T-shirts, polos, sweatshirts and hoodies chart (to fit chest)

Cernucci.note: tops chart shown on product pages (body measurements)

Charles Tyrwhitt.note: casual shirts; the chart gives chest 'up to', so L is over 41.5in up to 45in

Community Clothing.note: men's T-shirt chart shown in a product page's size guide: the garment's own chest, length and sleeve (XS is 39.4in round)

DeWalt Workwear.note: tops and jackets chart; workwear sizing runs large

Dubarry.note: men's clothing chart for outerwear, knits and polos (shown on product pages)

Folk.note: no general chart; chest laid flat from the relaxed-fit shirt's chart, doubled

Gabicci.note: Heritage knitwear chart; Heritage and Vintage shirts give the same to-fit chest

Gym King.note: men's chart (UK sizes); the site may open its US page, the chart is the same

Haglöfs.note: Size Guide A (most garments), one chest value per size

Jack Wolfskin.note: men's body chart kept on its product pages (Norbo shirt); the same on its other men's shirts

Jump the Gun.note: no general chart; pit-to-pit from the Oxford shirt's chart, doubled

KAVU.note: the chart says it gives body sizes

Luke 1977.note: no general chart; garment chest from the Hawich overshirt's own chart

Lyle & Scott.note: Men's Tops chart, one chest value per size

M and M Direct.note: the shop's general men's tops chart (it sells many brands)

M&S.note: Men's Tops guide; casual shirts use the same chest sizes

Mountain Warehouse.note: men's jackets and tops chart (cm row used)

New Era.note: Men (EU) apparel chart in a product page's size guide

O'Neill.note: men's tees chart; its hoodies, shirts and jackets charts give the same chest

Passenger.note: body chart in the product page's Size & Fit Guide

Percival.note: no general chart; pit-to-pit from the Drape Cuban shirt's chart, doubled

Peregrine.note: no general chart; chest laid flat from the Kenilworth shirt's measurements, doubled

Pretty Green.note: no general chart; pit-to-pit from a shirt's garment chart, doubled

Puma.note: no general chest chart; garment chest from a T-shirt's product measurements

Rains.note: no general chart; chest width from the Classic T-shirt's chart, doubled

Regatta.note: men's jackets, fleeces, gilets, shirts and T-shirts chart

Rydale.note: 'your chest size', one value per size

Saltrock.note: chart shown on a shirt's product page

Savile Row Company.note: classic-fit casual shirt chart; it also gives the shirt's own chest (L 50in)

Schöffel.note: polos and T-shirts chart; jackets and knitwear use numbered sizes

Sealskinz.note: chart shown on a shirt's product page

SikSilk.note: menswear tops chart in the shop's help centre (linked from its size-guide page); the cm ranges are used, its inch column gives one value per size (L 42in)

Spoke.note: Box Tee product measurements: chest laid flat, doubled

Stan Ray.note: no general chart; pit-to-pit from the quilted overshirt's chart, doubled

Superdry.note: men's size guide shown on product pages (chest table)

T.M. Lewin.note: casual shirts chart; their polo, T-shirt and knitwear chart puts L at 42-44in

Ted Baker.note: Ted size 4 is L; one chest value per size

Thought.note: men's guide in UK sizes (the site may open its US page)

TuffStuff.note: chest (approx) chart shown on its product pages; workwear sizing runs large

Uniqlo.note: no general chart; body width from the product's own measurements, doubled

Universal Textiles.note: the shop's general men's clothing guide (it sells several brands)

Universal Works.note: no general chart; chest width laid flat from a shirt's garment chart, doubled

Uskees.note: no general chart; chest laid flat from the Technique trek shirt's chart, doubled

Weekend Offender.note: T-shirts and polos chart: chest laid flat (pit to pit), doubled
